|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[IT-0 (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Your Force drains wherever you have a captive present are + 2. Immune to Restraining Bolt and attrition < 3. Once per game, may ▼ Hypo.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Wherever you have a captive, your Force drains are +2. Once per game, may deploy Hypo from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to Restraining Bolt and attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' “Your Force drains wherever” → “Wherever”; “captive present” → “captive, your Force drains”; “+ 2.” → “+2. Once per game, may deploy Hypo from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”; removed “Once per game, may ▼ Hypo.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 37. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[IT-O (Eyetee-Oh)]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
